comments.text: From turnkey-luk.6: the evaluation error links to docs/user-manual/src/configuration/buck2-integration.md#the-buck2-version, so that page needs a section headed 'The buck2 version' holding the migration note. Also: e2e/tests/05-brownfield-adoption.sh, docs/user-manual/src/configuration/toolchain-toml.md and getting-started/quick-start.md still declare buck2-toolchain; ADR 0001's 'unreachable cache => tests fail' consequence predates buck2 2026-09-15 (not ours to rewrite, but the manual must not repeat it).

title: Update docs, e2e and the migration note for the bundled buck2
